about_the_game:
THE PRIMALS — the official band of the online RPG, FINAL FANTASY XIV.

Live audio from their solo concert THE PRIMALS Live in Japan - Darkest Before Dawn, held at Yokohama Arena on September 21 and 22, 2024, is now available!

Featuring 21 tracks from the September 21 performance — including fan favorites up to the Dawntrail expansion, powerful rock sounds, special guest appearances, and even the encore — plus two additional songs performed exclusively on September 22.

*The tracklist differs from the Blu-ray version.

*This is an audio-only album and does not include video content.
